email_subject: Stage 3 Unlocked: Type-Safe Prompt Engineering (JSON, YAML & BAML)
headline: Stage 3 Mastery: Deterministic Rig & Code Automation
email_body:
Hey Justin!

You asked how our system automatically parses knob positions and feeds REAPER without breaking. Welcome to Stage 3: Structured Schemas (JSON, YAML & BAML).

When you tell an AI 'give me a table', standard LLMs often output conversational filler or malformed text. BAML (Boundary Abstract Modeling Language) guarantees the AI outputs 100% type-safe JSON or YAML that drops directly into REAPER Lua scripts or Python audio pipelines.

We deployed 'scripts/demo_structured_schemas.py' to your repo and unlocked Lab 8 on your portal: https://justin-netops-hub.web.app/demo_structured_schemas.py
